entries.0066b1744abca8e1: At the core of the Nitori Business, Nitori Co., Ltd. sells through domestic stores and mail order, NITORI FURNITURE VIETNAM EPE in Vietnam manufactures furniture sold within the group, and Home Deco Co., Ltd. manufactures curtains.
entries.163f3104de951d75: This category develops, manufactures and sells furniture and interior goods, and also handles real estate leasing, advertising services, logistics services and similar businesses. It is carried out by Nitori Co., Ltd., Home Logistics Co., Ltd. (logistics), NITORI FURNITURE VIETNAM EPE (furniture manufacturing in Vietnam), Home Deco Co., Ltd. (curtain manufacturing), Nitori Public Co., Ltd. (commissioned advertising) and sales companies in Taiwan and mainland China, among others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥803,548 million, the larger of the 2 reportable [[term:segment|segments]]. Segment profit was ¥118,381 million. The breakdown is store sales of ¥677,774 million, mail-order sales of ¥90,854 million and other sales of ¥27,070 million, to which is added other revenue of ¥7,849 million, mainly operating lease revenue. During the period it opened 40 Nitori stores and 22 Deco Home stores in Japan and a total of 30 stores overseas (6 in Taiwan, 3 in mainland China, 5 in Korea, 4 in Malaysia, 3 in Singapore, 2 in Thailand, 1 in Vietnam, 3 in the Philippines and 3 in Indonesia), bringing the number of stores at the end of the period to a total of 1,017, consisting of 808 in Japan and 209 overseas.
entries.20565e41b083a236: This category sells furniture, interior goods and home center products, and is carried out by Shimachu Co., Ltd., which became a subsidiary in 2021. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥108,699 million and segment profit was ¥7,212 million, turning to a profit increase from a segment loss of ¥1,288 million in the previous year. The breakdown is store sales of ¥98,705 million, mail-order sales of ¥692 million, other sales of ¥334 million and other revenue of ¥8,968 million. The number of stores at the end of the period was 52. As reasons for the profit increase, the company cites: advancing development of private brand products to raise their share of sales and improve the gross profit margin; optimizing advertising expenses by reducing the frequency of TV CM broadcasts and reviewing flyers; reducing logistics costs by moving delivery work from external contractors to the group company Home Logistics Co., Ltd.; and expanding or reducing sales floor space based on profit and loss by product category, along with opening Nitori stores in some stores and attracting external tenants.
entries.25627b3fa6b29485: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥125,526 million (¥117,665 million in the previous year), up 6.7% even as revenue declined. The operating margin rose from 12.7% in the previous year to 13.8%. Segment profit was ¥118,381 million for the Nitori Business (△0.5% year on year) and ¥7,212 million for the Shimachu Business (in the previous year, a segment loss of ¥1,288 million), and the improvement in the Shimachu Business was the main factor behind the increase in profit. After adjusting for financial income of ¥5,975 million and financial expenses of ¥4,144 million, profit before tax was ¥127,357 million, and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥89,270 million.

entries.41cfd1aeede18bae: This segment is handled by Home Logistics Co., Ltd. and Nitori (Taicang) Trading and Logistics Co., Ltd. Nitori (Taicang) Trading and Logistics Co., Ltd. also handles import agency services for products sold within the group. The company states that it is pursuing a logistics strategy project aimed at optimizing logistics functions from upstream to downstream, that all six of its own DCs (distribution centers) completed by the fiscal year ended March 2026 have come into full operation, and that it has been moving from leased DCs and dispatch centers to its own DCs. It has also begun introducing unloading robots (devanning robots).

entries.48776b52a202b36a: Nitori Holdings Co., Ltd. is a holding company, and the group consists of the company, 38 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]] and 1 equity-method affiliate. Its business is divided into two: the Nitori Business and the Shimachu Business, and its reportable [[term:segment|segments]] are also these two. The company describes its business model as a 'manufacturing, logistics, IT and retail business,' and its strength lies in handling everything in-house, from product development to manufacturing, logistics and sales. Its revenue inflows come from in-store sales, online sales (EC), and services such as real estate leasing, advertising and logistics. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, the Nitori Business had 808 stores in Japan and 209 overseas, and the Shimachu Business had 52 stores, bringing the total number of stores at the end of the period to 1,069. No customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue, and revenue from external customers in Japan accounts for most of the group's revenue.

(Taiwan), Mingying Shangmao (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., Nitori (Shanghai) Home Furnishing Co., Ltd., Nitori (Shanghai) Home Furnishing Sales Co., Ltd. and others. entries.b3d19f6e73ed2beb: Its main customers are consumers who buy furniture, interior goods and household goods, and revenue from external customers in Japan accounts for most of the group's revenue. Overseas, it has 73 stores in Taiwan, 78 in mainland China, 3 in Hong Kong, 5 in South Korea, 14 in Malaysia, 6 in Singapore, 12 in Thailand, 4 in Vietnam, 7 in the Philippines, 6 in Indonesia and 1 in India, for a total of 209 stores. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, same-store customer count in Japan was 92.8% of the prior year's level and same-store sales were 95.8% of the prior year's level, and the company states that it recognizes the cause of the decline in customer count as not having sufficiently developed new products with superior design, functionality and price competitiveness, and therefore not having been able to make timely product proposals. No customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue.

entries.dd2d990227d01855: Nitori Holdings Co., Ltd. is a holding company with 38 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 equity-method affiliate under it. Its major companies are Nitori Co., Ltd., which sells furniture and interior goods in Japan; Shimachu Co., Ltd., which operates home centers; Home Logistics Co., Ltd., which handles logistics; NITORI FURNITURE VIETNAM EPE, which manufactures furniture; Home Deco Co., Ltd., which manufactures curtains; Nitori Public Co., Ltd., which handles advertising; and the sales companies in Taiwan and mainland China. Kachitas Co., Ltd., an equity-method affiliate, operates a business that refurbishes used housing. Nitori Co., Ltd. and Shimachu Co., Ltd. each account for more than 10% of consolidated revenue, and for the fiscal year ended March 2026, Nitori Co., Ltd.'s revenue was ¥749,940 million and Shimachu Co., Ltd.'s was ¥110,274 million.
